title: High-Temperature Modeling
body:
This record covers High-Temperature Modeling within the Extreme-Environment Simulation Database. Models heat, cold, pressure, vibration and other defined environmental conditions. The record is written as a complete, human-readable file: it states what the method is, when it applies, what it needs, what it produces, and where its limits lie.

How it works. Envelope method: defined environmental extremes are applied as loads and boundary conditions, and margins are reported against design limits. In a simple case the method is applied to a single, well-defined item; in a compounded case several items are combined and their interactions are tracked; in the most complex case the full chain is carried end to end with checks at each stage.

Worked example. The demo program attached to this record executes the worked calculation for this topic at build time, and its output is stored beside the code so any reader can compare the two. The numbers in the demo are ordinary working values for this topic, chosen so the arithmetic can be checked by hand as well as by running the program.
